newsitem.title: USA: Ramtron says loses patent decision.
newsitem.headline: Ramtron says loses patent decision.

text.p: Ramtron International Corp said it has received an adverse decision from the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office in a patent interference case.
The company did not disclose the exact nature of the case but said it involves one of its 40 issued U.S. patents.

Ramtron, a semiconductor manufacturer, said it intends to pursue its legal appeal options, which may include further proceedings in the Patent Office, Federal District Court, or the Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit.
"In light of this development, the company will pursue further legal remedies as planned," Chairman and Chief Executive L. David Sikes said in a statement.

"Ramtron is the senior party in this matter and remains in possession of this issued patent throughout continuing legal proceedings. We have vigorously defended our patent rights in this interference contest and will continue such efforts," Sikes added. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
